end.summary: Linked harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready; 2 of 3 responses were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised connecting harvest festivals with crop readiness and comparing celebrations across regions. They first said festival dates were random, then corrected this by explaining that harvest festivals happen when crops are ready; they also described Diwali using rangoli, diyas, new clothes, and sweets. At home, ask Kavya to name one harvest festival and explain what season or crop it connects to.
